EventMap Zimbabwe

Event Discovery & Services Platform

A digital platform I founded and developed to make discovering events, opportunities, and event-related services easier in Zimbabwe.

The platform brings together event listings, opportunities, and service providers in one accessible space, helping users find relevant experiences while giving organisers and businesses a platform to reach their audiences.

My contribution · Founder & Developer

I led the project from concept to implementation, handling product planning, interface design, frontend development, and deployment. I continue to develop and improve the platform based on its evolving needs.

Connected care.Web & mobile application
02

Mainteco

Maintenance Management System · Web & Mobile

A facility maintenance management system designed to simplify maintenance requests, work orders, and day-to-day maintenance activities.

The platform brings tenants, maintenance teams, and technicians into one connected system to report issues, assign work, monitor progress, and maintain visibility. Web and mobile applications support maintenance management across devices.

My contribution · Mobile Development

I contribute to the mobile application, translating maintenance requirements into functional features and user-friendly workflows. My work focuses on asset management, maintenance requests, work orders, preventive maintenance, and role-based access.
